notes.title: Quietus Allurement Demo Update 13: Quality of Life update
notes.notes:
General Update
Its been a while since we had an update about where the game is at. Well this update is defiantly going to help overall with the game. Are we getting closer to release not really I want the game to be the best it can be with the launch. With this update it defiantly feels more like a finished product.

This update has been in the works for a while and with the changes that I've made Its defiantly a quality of life update. As Recoil is now a whole new system. This system has been rewritten over and over to find the right correct way of doing it. It finally turned into something I really enjoy.  

We are still in progress working on making the survival map look more like it should! And making further changes on the playstyle to make it fit the genre of game.

We made Level 1 a little bit more interesting with the lights but we got more work to do yet. It still seems out of place. not fitting the genre.

Updated: Save/Loading code this will break current saves! I’m hoping this will work for the next update later on.

Fixed: Breaking Platforms now save correctly.

Fixed: Saving game No longer brakes audio

Fixed: Loading Game wasn’t setting the audio correctly for voice lines.

Added: Switching weapons now makes a sound.

Weapons smoke effect only happens on non silenced weapons

Weapons with silencer have a smaller flare and removal of smoke

Weapon recoil has changed a lot making weapons a lot easier to control. 



Electric

BUG: Does Not have a fire rate for auto. Have fun with this while you can. ːsteamhappyː


Story Mode

Fixed: Player head glowing in Level 1.

Fixed: Player doesn't look like he's in a jump when he should be walking.

Fixed: Player was getting stuck on the elevator not letting them jump and appeared to be floating when on the platform.

Fixed: Elevator Sign clipping through player.

Fixed: Potential Issue with saving and loading. THIS WILL BREAK CURRENT SAVES!

Added: Drops are now affected by gravity

Updated: Ground Monsters are a little smarter.

The starting area looks a little bit different. It's still working progress but it's getting there.

notes.title: Quietus Allurement Demo Update 7: 4K resolution Release!
notes.notes:
As many of you know this update has a lot of changes to it like major improvements and removing the duplicates and redundancies of the game. So updates will be faster to change and will apply to all and not just one game mode or other things. This update has the ability for a higher screen resolutions then just 1920x1080 which is awesome and no more ARROWs.. The arrows in the video settings have been removed! as much as that system worked it was just to the point where it needed to be retired and changed to what it is now. Here is the overall Patch notes of the game which is still heavily being update and more demo updates will be coming!

Patch Notes
Added: up to 4k resolutions and a new selection feature for all video options.
Added: Options menu now shows more options for controls that are planned for full release of the game. Steam Deck and controller. We are working on controller support in the next patch or two. Down below shows our phases and these will stay on each update to give you a heads up when you might see this happening..
Added: info page has changed and more pages have been added. Info for these new pages is still work in progress at the moment.
Added: New Sniper Scope system with zoom. Still work in progress will see more changes to them soon.
Fixed: Crash with sprinting in chapter 1 level 1.
Fixed: Voicelines in Chapter 1 Level 1 were being skipped.
Fixed: Cursor image was incorrectly displayed in the info screen.
Fixed: Crash with weapon showcase when clicking on sniper rifles
Changed/Optimization: This change isn't going to be noticeable but it will make the options menu a little easier to expand on to the future.
Removed: work in progress on survival menu option.
Controller Support
This will be implemented in three phases.
Phase 1: This phase consists of the main menu phase so anything in menus should be working. Will need more testing to find out for sure!
Phase 2: This phase consists of the full game being able to be played with a controller..
Phase 3: This phase consists of bug fixes. Improvements to overall controller support.

Survival Changes
Removed: info button in survival menu as the info menu on the main menu has all the info needed for both.
Changed: Ground Monsters are now alerted later meaning less range and attack with less range. To allow more time to kill them. Developer Notes I thought this change was better than lowering the damage for now. More changes will be evaluated as time goes on.

Known issues
This isn't very important just looks a little strange but it will be fix in the next update..
Chapter 1: Level 1: has a lighting issue bug.

notes.title: Devlopment Progress #18 Changes are coming!
notes.notes:
So, it’s been almost two months since the last update and here’s a list of stuff we have been working on.
Sniper Scopes
I know this was not working properly in survival mode and I’ve been trying to figure out a new system for this to work better. After a lot of late nights thinking and long days of coding. There’s a new system going into place where its smoother and some surprises will be coming with that. Not only will this system work in story it also works in survival.
Info pages
The info pages are being added to the game this area kind of lack in the fact that it was very basic but I’m working on adding this in so we can get closer to finished. So the main focus after finishing these things will be the full game then.
Options Menu Changes
These are mainly just code changes but, in the controls, there is going to be changes in the fact that I’m getting prepared to add more options. New options are for Controller and Steam deck. Yes, I’m working towards having my game work with steam deck as much as possible.  I’m also working on getting stuff set up for controller. Support for controller is not there yet but we are working towards that and trying to improve those systems.

As always, I can’t thank you all enough for the support. This is my first game I’m really wanting to release and give to you all and these changes are slow but I’m working as hard as I can do for one person.

notes.title: Quietus Allurement Demo Update #2
notes.notes:
The demo has been progressing and I've been working on taking a lot of consideration into the game and what I want the game to be. I had to think long and hard about the upcoming weapon nerfs but I think this will make the game just a bit harder with higher tier weapons which is a good thing. Down below is all the Fixes and additions I made in the update! There will be more updates to come! to improve overall gameplay and get ready to release the survival mode!


Update News!
Added: Elevator sign since it wasn’t as noticeable as what I thought it would be.
Added: other player arm to hornet weapon textures
Added: lights in the dark level after elevator or stairs
Added: Sprinting while reloading isn’t possible anymore.
Added: Game Overlay description has been added to the info page This is still work in progress. I just want to add this so people can know more about the game overlay and more details will be added soon.
Fixed: Blood background on death doesn’t work with certain levels 
Fixed: Audio loops with phantom and monster when attacking.
Fixed: Monsters going right through the spikes.
Fixed: Destroyer was still using the old damage system.
Fixed: Flying monsters facing the wrong way when spawning in then fixing themselves.
Changed: door Texture in story mode
Weapon Changes
Tac-P2002 max damage reduced by 5.
Arctic Freeze max damage reduced by 4.
The weapons below are nerfed by fire-rate and magazine size.
Warhead max damage reduced by 14.

Rampage max damage reduced by 8.
Eradicator max damage reduced by 15.

Updated stats to show correct damages above.

notes.title: Development Progress #7 Demo Release Status
notes.notes:
Its been really busy during the holidays, so I haven't had time to post but now I have time, I hope everyone had a really merry Christmas and a good happy new years!

Some of you may know that the demo launches In less then one month! The demo will be released on the steam store for the up coming steam next fest! The demo will be skipping level 1 due to it being a tutorial level and the tutorial level is not going to be finished at this time. It might get done before the demo releases but I don't think it will. So the current status of the demo includes
[olist]
Story mode will have 4-5 levels I say that because there is 5 levels because one of the levels has a different route you can take but only 4 total also you'll face 2 different monster types and 24 total weapons to play with. Every weapon is unlocked.
Survival mode This mode will not be in at release. being that this has only been in development for less than a year its been a lot of work for a single person to get it working the way I want to. but the demo will be updated as things get developed so when this is ready to go the demo will include 1 map for you to try out! The map currently in development is called Santa's Workshop.
[/olist]

The reason I'm doing steam next fest now is because I feel like the game is at that point of that 20-30 minute demo play and with all the work I've made this year I have a good feeling of trying to release the game either Late this year or early 2024 if all goes well!

notes.title: Development Progress #6 Survival update
notes.notes:
Happy thanksgiving everyone! hope you all have a great day today! 

In game news is there is a whole entirely new menu built for my game that is going to be in the survival part of the game! I know it's not going to be in the demo at the launch but I'm trying my hardest to get to that point! Lately its been a lot about survival and in the next couple of weeks I'm hoping to work more on the story and get more progress on that!

Its a little short post today being that it is thanksgiving but I will have more details coming soon on everything that I've been working on.
